html: † [מַלָּח] n.m. mariner (loan-word from Assyrian malaḫu DlHWB 412 cf. Id.Prol. 178; HalZA iv. 1889, 53; so also Aramaic ܡܰܠܳܚܳܐ (v. Brock), whence Arabic مَلَّاحٌ Frä221);—pl. מַלָּחִים Jon 1:5 Ez 27:29; מַלָּחַיִךְ Ez 27:27; מַלָּחֵיהֶם v 9 (BaNB 49 Anm. 3);—mariners, sailors of ship going to Tarshish Jon 1:5 (cf. רַב הַחֹבֵל v 6); to Tyre Ez 27:9, cf. v 27:29 (‖ חֹבְלִים).
